en.title: FAA orders fuel tank sealant inspections on certain Boeing 787s over lightning-strike explosion risk
en.summary: The FAA has issued an airworthiness directive ordering inspections of certain Boeing 787-8, 787-9 and 787-10 aircraft over center wing fuel tank sealant installations that lacked evidence of required adhesion testing, warning that defective sealant could create an ignition source during a lightning strike.
body: The US Federal Aviation Administration has issued an airworthiness directive, published November 2, 2026, ordering inspections of certain Boeing 787-8, 787-9 and 787-10 aircraft. The directive concerns center wing fuel tank sealant installations that lacked evidence of required adhesion testing, an issue Boeing identified during production.

The FAA warned that defective sealant could create an ignition source within the center wing fuel tank during a lightning strike, increasing the risk of a fuel tank explosion. Operators must inspect sealant in the left and right center wing fuel tanks and carry out adhesion tests where sealant was not previously verified, completing the work within 12 months of the directive's effective date, and repair any defects using approved procedures. The agency estimated about 34 hours of work per aircraft at $2,890 each, or $173,400 for the 60 affected US aircraft excluding repairs, and said some expenses could be covered under Boeing's warranty.

zh.title: FAA下令檢查部分波音787中央油箱密封膠，防範雷擊爆炸風險
zh.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署發布適航指令，要求檢查部分波音787-8、787-9與787-10客機的中央翼油箱密封膠，因為相關安裝缺乏必要的黏著測試證據，缺陷密封膠可能在雷擊時形成引火源。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署發布適航指令，要求檢查部分波音787-8、787-9與787-10客機。這項於2026年11月2日發布的指令針對中央翼油箱密封膠安裝，相關安裝缺乏必要的黏著測試證據，而這項問題是波音在生產過程中發現的。
聯邦航空總署警告，缺陷密封膠可能在雷擊時於中央翼油箱內形成引火源，進而提高油箱爆炸風險。業者必須檢查左右中央翼油箱的密封膠，並在先前未驗證的部位進行黏著測試，於指令生效日起12個月內完成，發現缺陷則依核准程序修復。該署估計每架飛機約需34小時工時、每架2,890美元，60架受影響的美國飛機合計173,400美元（不含修復費用），部分費用可能由波音保固涵蓋。
